points.description: States that terminal 4 is not separated from (i.e. is directly/electrically connected to) the negative battery terminal, with no component or break between them, so the voltmeter reads the full battery voltage of 1.5 V. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying terminal 4 is connected to the negative battery terminal with nothing (no component/resistance) between them. No marks for vague statements like 'there is a circuit' without this idea.
